instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Management consulting firm serving mid-market companies with strategy, operational excellence, and digital transformation engagements. The team is lean and highly specialized, focusing on niche expertise to drive tangible results for clients.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our engineering team adopted an agile methodology last year, moving from waterfall-style quarterly releases to 2-week sprints with continuous deployment. This reduced our release cycle time by 60% and improved cross-functional collaboration. However, adjacent teams (marketing, support) are still adapting to the faster cadence.
answers.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. Our priority is defending our installed base — reducing churn, strengthening switching costs, and matching the digital experience our competitors offer without triggering a destructive price war.
answers.additionalContext: The firm is currently operating with minimal dedicated resources for proactive innovation, relying heavily on consultants' self-service knowledge sharing to maintain service quality.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Knowledge Capture & Proposal Generation
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a system to capture and surface past engagement insights directly addresses the bottleneck of proposal development and knowledge loss within the firm. This is a high-leverage, low-cost incremental step that immediately enhances service delivery speed.

first_actions: Identify and pilot an internal AI tool (e.g., LLM integration) for extracting key recommendations from project reports.
Allocate 5% of the current operational budget for subscription costs or development time for a MVP.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in proposal drafting time by 30%
milestones: Month 1: Tool selection and data integration setup.
Month 3: Internal pilot completion and workflow integration.

opportunities.title: Client Experience Subscription Model (CX-SaaS)
opportunities.rationale: To defend against pricing pressures, the firm could shift from pure project billing to a recurring retainer that offers access to proprietary consulting frameworks or real-time operational dashboards. This creates predictable revenue and significantly increases switching costs.

first_actions: Develop a lean 'Consultant Advisory' package prototype with existing high-value clients.
Conduct market validation interviews (Qualitative feedback) on pricing elasticity.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 20% conversion of retained clients to recurring advisory contracts within the year.
milestones: Month 4: Develop legal and operational framework for subscription service.
Month 9: Launch pilot program with 5 anchor clients.

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated 'Future Initiatives Task Force' and define the top three high-impact incremental projects for Q3.
Schedule deep-dive workshops with Generalist Developers to map internal skill gaps related to digital maturity (specifically CRM/workflow automation).

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated innovation resource leading to opportunistic, sporadic efforts.
High dependency on key personnel (talent) and difficulty in cross-training due to the tight team size.
Low digital maturity resulting in reliance on manual processes for knowledge management and client interaction.
